title: Plugin job types for actions
description: Response from GET /cms-api/v1/admin/actions/plugin-job-types. The job types that enabled plugins offer to actions (C12): the editor builds the job's plugin_config form from config_schema.

type.description: The job_type value to put in the action job.

plugin_id.description: The plugin that offers the type.

config_schema.description: Flat JSON Schema (type object, properties, required) of plugin_config; a string property with format variable-text may hold {{variables}}.

resource_fields.description: Property of plugin_config => resource type of the plugin item it holds; the editor must be allowed to view the item.
